articles.title: MAGA: Why Trump's movement is fracturing?
articles.summary:
As the 2026 midterm elections approach, divisions within the MAGA camp are becoming increasingly visible. From the war in Iran and rising fuel prices to the Epstein files, several of Trump’s decisions are fuelling divisions among his most loyal supporters.
 
Once united by a shared vision of America, MAGA now brings together factions that increasingly disagree over foreign policy, the economy and what “America First” should actually mean. Yet Trump remains the central figure holding this political coalition together – and he is fighting to keep it that way.
 
Why are some of the president’s longtime allies distancing themselves from him? Can MAGA remain united despite these disagreements? And can Trump still mobilise his base ahead of the midterms?
 
🔍 Our journalist Stella Elgersma breaks down the divisions within the MAGA movement and Donald Trump’s strategy to rally his supporters, once again.

articles.title: Brazil’s victory for the planet and democracy: seven lessons from Lula’s win
articles.summary:
The trouncing of the far right provides a playbook for social and environmental movements in other countries facing elections, including the US, Spain and France

Thank you, Brazil, for demonstrating how the far right can be trounced while protection for the Amazon is strengthened. In a world where nature and democracy appeared to be bleeding out in tandem, voters and forest defenders in this global south powerhouse have shown it is possible to staunch the flow. This should provide much needed inspiration and, more practically, a playbook for social and environmental movements in other countries facing elections, including the US, Spain and France.

The astonishing comeback victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Sunday’s presidential runoff against his extreme right challenger Flavío Bolsonaro has brought oceans of rapturous supporters on to the streets, while also thrilling conservationists, climate activists and social justice campaigners across the world.

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro’s defeat is a major blow to Trump and his orange wave
articles.summary:
The far-right candidate was supposed to claim the presidency, but Brazilian voters had other ideas

For Donald Trump, Brazil’s presidential election was meant to represent the crest of the “orange wave” – a three-year surge of rightwing triumphs that has reshaped Latin American politics in the US president’s tangerine-hued image.

The far-right candidate, Flávio Bolsonaro, was supposed to claim the presidency on Sunday, bringing the region’s biggest democracy and economy into Trump’s orbit, after similar victories in Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Honduras, Ecuador and Peru – not to mention the capture of Venezuela’s government after the country was invaded in January.

archive.security_status_cs: Region Jižní Ameriky čelí extrémnímu napětí kvůli vyhrocenému prezidentskému run-offu v Brazílii, kde stojí proti sobě úřadující prezident Lula a far-rightový vyzývatel Flávio Bolsonaro. archive.security_status_en: The South American region is facing extreme tension due to the fiercely contested presidential runoff in Brazil between incumbent President Lula and far-right challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. Meanwhile, global commodity markets have been rattled by US tariff threats on Colombian coffee, while security crises in the Andean region and Haiti deepen instability.

archive.forecast_en: In the coming hours, markets will fully absorb the results of the Brazilian presidential runoff, setting the direction for regional currencies and assets. Persistent elevated volatility is expected across Brazilian markets and commodities.

archive.security_status_cs: Brazílie prožívá vyostřené prezidentské volby s těsným soubojem mezi stávajícím prezidentem Luizem Ináciem Lulou da Silvou a Fláviem Bolsonarem, což vyvolává silnou společenskou polarizaci. V Argentině mezitím pokračují politické střety a korupční kauzy kolem vysoce postavených politiků, zatímco globální komoditní trhy reagují na napětí v obchodu s kávou a ropou.
archive.security_status_en: Brazil is experiencing a fiercely contested presidential runoff between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, driving intense social polarization. Meanwhile, Argentina faces ongoing political clashes and high-profile corruption trials, as global commodity markets react to tensions in coffee and oil trade.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších hodinách budou trhy plně vstřebávat výsledky brazilského prezidentského run-offu, což určí krátkodobý trend pro regionální měny a akcie. Zvýšená volatilita a opatrnost investorů přetrvají minimálně do ustálení politické situace.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming hours, markets will fully absorb the results of the Brazilian presidential runoff, setting the short-term trend for regional currencies and equities. Heightened volatility and investor caution will persist at least until the political situation stabilizes.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní Amerika čelí vysoké politické nestabilitě, již dominují extrémně těsné prezidentské volby v Brazílii mezi levicovým Lulou a pravicovým Fláviem Bolsonarem. V Argentině pokračuje napjaté ekonomické manévrování prezidenta Mileie pod tlakem blížících se voleb a rostoucí inflace. Region nadále zatěžují strukturální problémy, jako jsou dopady nemocí drůbeže na exporty, kolísavé ceny komodit a přetrvávající bezpečnostní krize v Andském regionu.
archive.security_status_en: South America is facing high political instability, dominated by the exceptionally tight Brazilian presidential runoff between left-winger Lula and right-winger Flávio Bolsonaro. In Argentina, President Milei's tense economic maneuvering continues amid approaching elections and inflationary pressures. The region remains burdened by structural issues such as poultry disease impacts on exports, volatile commodity prices, and persistent security crises in the Andean region.
archive.forecast_cs: Trhy v nejbližších dnech plně vstřebají výsledky brazilského prezidentského run-offu, což vyvolá prudké pohyby na měnových trzích. Investoři budou nadále bedlivě sledovat vývoj inflace a politické stability v Argentině a Ando-karibském regionu.
archive.forecast_en: Markets will fully digest the results of the Brazilian presidential runoff in the coming days, triggering sharp currency movements. Investors will continue to closely monitor inflation trends and political stability in Argentina and the Andean-Caribbean region.

archive.security_status_cs: Brazílie čelí hluboké politické polarizaci a protestům tábora poraženého Flávia Bolsonara po těsném vítězství Luize Inácia Luly da Silvy ve druhém kole prezidentských voleb. archive.security_status_en: Brazil faces deep political polarization and protests from the camp of defeated Flávio Bolsonaro following the narrow runoff victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Meanwhile, in Venezuela, the return from exile of opposition leader María Corina Machado has reignited tensions with the interim government of Delcy Rodríguez, as global markets absorb commodity and currency volatility. Security risks tied to organized crime persist across the Andean-Caribbean region, notably in Haiti and Ecuador.
archive.forecast_cs: Trhy v nejbližších dnech plně vstřebají výsledky brazilského prezidentského run-offu a reakce tábora poražených, což vyvolá přechodnou volatilitu na brazilském reálu i tamní burze. archive.forecast_en: Markets will fully absorb the results of the Brazilian presidential runoff and the defeated camp's response in the coming days, triggering transitional volatility on the Brazilian real and B3 exchange. archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued political tension is expected in Brazil as the opposition attempts to challenge election results, keeping currency volatility high.
